body.statement: For every admissible radius triple \((r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\in[0,\bar r]^3\), the handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{lb}}\) yields constants \(c>0\) and \(\delta_0\in(0,1/4)\), uniform in \(n\), such that every rule \(T\in\mathcal T_n\), including every rule using \(O^{(n)}\), \(m_0\), \(m_1\), \(p\), and the certified radii, obeys \(\sup_{(P,m_0,m_1,p)\in\mathcal M_n}P\{|T(O^{(n)},m_0,m_1,p,r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})-\tau(P)|\ge c\rho_n\}\ge\delta_0\). Consequently \(\mathfrak R_n^{(1)}\ge c\delta_0\rho_n\) and \(\mathfrak R_n^{(2)}\ge c\sqrt{\delta_0}\rho_n\). Every fixed-sign law used by the fuzzy mixtures, rather than merely the mixtures themselves, belongs to \(\mathcal M_n\). Each of the four subexperiment families satisfies \(E_P[(g_1(X)-g_0(X))^2]\le M\) by regression-amplitude calibration within the applicable nuisance radius or a sufficiently small fixed constant.
body.justification: This shell-matching converse certifies all four obstructions against the full public-information decision class.
body.gap: JinSyrgkanis2024StructureAgnosticDR and KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE provide fuzzy-hypothesis templates, but not the shell-preserving collision and empty-treatment channels for this ATE experiment.
body.consumer: The lower bound certifies that no estimator using the sample and the same public predictions can remove any one of the four rate components.
